question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE kind IN ('line','ocr','figure_fact') AND (text ILIKE '%1500%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%cycle%') ORDER BY page, id

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'([0-9]+) mAh',1) AS DOUBLE) AS cyc1500, CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'reversible capacity of ([0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS rev1C, CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'([0-9]+) mAh',1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'reversible capacity of ([0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM atoms a, atoms b WHERE a.id='p5.L103' AND b.id='p5.L87'
